annotations.title: Why was.
annotations.text: So wicked, couetous, and sacrilegious persons reprehend good men for bestowing their goods vpon Church ornaments &c. <mn>◦</mn> vnder pretence of better bestowing them on the poore. such prouide for the poore as Iudas did.

annotations.title: A theefe.
annotations.text: Iudas did not then first perish when he sould our Lord, for he was a theefe before: and being lost he yet folowed Christ, not in hart, but in body onely. Which our Maister tolerated, ◦ to giue vs a lesson to tolerate the il, rather then deuide the body. Aug. tract. 50 in Io.
